title: On Periodic Solutions of the Zakharov-Rubenchik System
summary: We study the one-dimensional Zakharov-Rubenchik system with periodic initial conditions. This system models the interaction of low-frequency waves with high-frequency waves in different physical phenomena. Using semigroup theory, we prove the global well-posedness of the associated linear equation in $H^q(\mathbb{T})\times H^s(\mathbb{T})\times H^{s+1}(\mathbb{T})$, $q,s \in \mathbb{R}$.
